title: Who do you think is ox-alpha?
body:
Who owns ox-alpha what do you think?

Im using it like crazy cause its free and strong it really feels like fable level but better.

I give him a prompt he works 10-90mins and literally give me results. no troubles.

Ofc its only for vibe-coding 3d game. But whats the best way to test out new model, ofc its a game.

Yes it is still free on openrouter and opencode till 27.08.2026.

submitted by /u/arthax33
summaryZh: 社区用户热议一款名为ox-alpha的免费开源模型，探讨其在3D游戏开发（vibe-coding）中的出色表现与实际应用体验。该模型目前在部分平台上免费提供至2026年8月27日。
